snippet.title: Which Day Is the Best Day? ☀️ Friday, Jumu'ah! | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Which day of the week is the best day? Friday, the day of Jumu'ah!

Our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) said: "The best day the sun rises on is Friday."

My Friday list: take a nice bath, put on clean clothes and a little nice smell, go to the masjid for the Jumu'ah prayer, and make lots of dua to Allah. Jumu'ah Mubarak!

What will your little one do this Friday?

Source
• Sahih Muslim 854: https://sunnah.com/muslim:854a

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: muhammadarhamamin77800 on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-198164/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. All characters are faceless.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at
